WITH RECURSIVE history(event_no, action, linked_event, signed_change) AS (
  SELECT event_no, action, linked_event, 1
  FROM print_events
  WHERE print_code = 'P7' AND action = 'issue' AND linked_event IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.event_no, e.action, e.linked_event, h.signed_change * e.link_sign
  FROM history AS h
  JOIN print_events AS e ON e.linked_event = h.event_no
)
SELECT event_no, action, linked_event, signed_change,
       SUM(signed_change) OVER (ORDER BY event_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS active_after
FROM history
ORDER BY event_no ASC
